title: The James L. and Nellie M. Westlake Scholarship Program
text:
This scholarship is available for Missouri residents.

Requirements[edit]

  • Applicant must be a Missouri resident
  • Must be a graduating senior at a Missouri high school who plans to enroll in a full-time undergraduate course of study at an accredited four-year college or university - OR - have completed one or two full years at a Missouri community college with sufficient credits to permit transfer to an accredited four-year college or university at the sophomore or junior level, respectively
  • Must demonstrate limited financial resources with an expected family contribution of <dollar/>7,000 or less and a family adjusted gross income of <dollar/>50,000 or less.


The award will cover the cost of tuition plus money for books and fees.

Starting in December, visit sms.scholarshipamerica.org/westlake for more information and the application.
